text:
ina: Quick UX check: I'm exploring an alternative to legend toggles for busy dashboards. Idea: per-legend "compact" chip that reduces a series to a tiny inline sparkline + median dot. When points are extreme (we detect via threshold) the chip shows a small badge '2 outliers' which can be expanded. Mock attached.

mars: I like it. It reduces height and keeps color association. Two copy questions: '2 outliers' vs '2 clipped' vs '2 hidden'  leaning toward 'outliers' for clarity.

liam: Accessibility: chips must be operable by keyboard and announced by screen readers. Suggested label: `button"Compact series: DB qps. 2 outliers hidden"`. Ensure the expand control uses aria-expanded and manages focus to the expanded mini-list.

tess: Implementation detail: what is the clipping rule? I suggest percentile-based: clip values above the 99.9th percentile OR > 20x median, whichever triggers first. Log event `chart_clip` with `method=percentile|factor`.

omar: Visual nuance: when smoothing is on for the main chart, the mini-sparkline should either match smoothing or show a small 's' icon indicating smoothing is applied. Otherwise users might misinterpret trend.

gwen: Minor copy nit: instead of 'expand' in tooltip use 'view' since 'expand' may imply layout shift. Tooltip text suggestion: '2 outliers hidden. View values.'

ina: Behaviour question: auto-collapse vs suggest-only? I propose non-invasive suggestion banner the first time a heavy outlier is detected: 'Large spike detected in DB qps. Compact high values?' with options 'Compact', 'Show all', 'Never for this chart'. Keep default manual.

mars: Agree on suggest-only. Auto Collapsing could mask regressions. Also add a legend context menu entry 'Treat extremes as separate series' for power users to toggle creating a derived series of outliers.

liam: Keyboard shortcut idea: focus legend, press 'k' to toggle compact on the focused series. Add this to the keyboard shortcuts help. Also when the badge is focused, screen reader should read '2 outliers hidden, press Enter to view'.

tess: Edge cases: stacked or stacked-percent charts  compaction would be confusing. Hide the compact control for stacked charts and show an inline hint: 'Compaction not supported for stacked views'.

omar: Analytics: track `compact_toggle` with `origin=legend|suggestion|shortcut` and `was_auto_suggested=true|false`. We want to know how often users accept suggestions.

gwen: Visual accessibility: ensure contrast for the badge meets AA when placed on dark backgrounds. Also test with a couple of colorblind palettes to ensure the mini-sparkline is still legible.

ina: I'll iterate on mocks with two copy variants (terse + friendly) and include aria attributes and keyboard flow in the annotations. Will upload frames in ~3h. If anyone can do a quick a11y pass once they're in, that'd be great.

mars: Happy to review the a11y pass.

liam: I can run 2 quick keyboard navigation checks after frames land.

ina: Thanks all :sparkles:
